title: tidy --apply removes a live worker's worktree locked by Claude Code and deletes its work branch
goal: backlog.py tidy keeps every locked worktree (a Claude Code agent's lock included: tidy is clone-wide and cannot tell a finished worker from one that has not committed yet) and the branch checked out there, naming the lock; only close, which knows its sprint's items, releases an agent-locked worktree. A planted locked clean worktree at main's tip survives tidy --apply. Found by the SP-6btkjg4l review.

run: import sys,pathlib;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land;e={'path':pathlib.Path('/nonexistent/agent-x'),'lock':'claude agent agent-x (pid 1)','head':'0'*40};sys.exit(0 if (bl_land.tidy_worktree_kept('.',e,'refs/heads/main') or '').startswith('it is locked') else 1)
